title: parse_request discards structured error from serde (see JMAP-51b.3)
description: parse_request map_err(|_| ...) discards the serde error entirely. The plain key insight from the rusty pass: the error should be preserved in description for operator diagnostics. Same as JMAP-51b.3 but filed separately for idiom tracking. Fix: map_err(|e| JmapError::not_request()) then attach e.to_string() via description.
